Name: Giant Flowers for Cornucopia - More Flowers
Author: Canimia
Description:
This mod adds some giant versions of flowers from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url].

I haven't done all of the flowers, but I'll try to add more in the future when I get the time to make more sprites.

﻿This mod does include giant versions of multi-yield flowers. I've made it configurable so you can disable those flowers if you'd rather not have them destroy your multi-yield crops. If you do enable them, they'll drop double the items a normal giant crop drops.

[b][u]Current Giant Flowers in this mod:[/u][/b]
Pansy
Iris
Lily
Chrysanthemum
Pink Cat
Pitcher Plant
Blue Mist
Lotus - [color=#93c47d]new![/color]

[b][u]Recommended Mods:[/u][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23144]
Neo's Giant Flowers CP (1.6)[/url] for even more giant flowers for your game.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]6480's Giant Crops[/url] adds lots of great giant crops, too.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22927?tab=description]Giant Crops for Cornucopia More Crops Plus Some Vanilla Crops[/url]

This is my first mod, and I'd never done much sprite work before, either.﻿﻿ Critiques are welcome!
